about_text:
Welcome to my website!
My name is Dinara Agapashayevna, and for 7 years I have been an official partner and expert of the Czech company Essens.
Over these years, I have gone from a person who simply fell in love with the quality of European perfume and products to a leader helping others change their lives.
Seven years in one project is not just stability; it is a deep knowledge of the product, all the intricacies of marketing, and a clear understanding of how everyone can earn here.
